rules: Never delete a specialist capability when consolidating a bot profile.
Keep the original slug as a reversible alias so saved links and user requests continue to work.
Choose a master inside the same division unless Buddy is explicitly the global master.
Only call a bot low-use when usage telemetry covers the configured window; missing telemetry is unknown, not zero.
Exact or near-duplicate specialists may be merge candidates even without usage telemetry when their capability overlap is proven.
A master must inherit the union of capabilities from merged aliases before a merge can become active.
Consolidation must not reduce fleet capability coverage, certification evidence, approval gates, or routing traceability.
Every merge must be reversible by restoring the alias as a directly routed specialist.
Default Buddy routing may prefer master bots while explicit specialist slugs remain supported.
Master-bot routing changes require fleet regression tests before production activation.
